title: Linux server readiness
description: Can this solution move to a Linux-based FileMaker Server? Linux has practically no exclusive features - the Linux question is the INVERSE of a binding inventory: this view consolidates everything in scope that works on macOS/Windows FileMaker Server but not (or not reliably) on Linux. Three signal sources: plug-in functions available under the server script engine but without a Linux build (verbatim vendor flags folded through the curated OS map, resolved against the reference host matrix; includes custom-function wrappers), Claris calculation functions documented as unsupported on Linux hosts (source-true inverse statements, CF-transitive), and Claris script steps with a Linux-unsupported statement (currently none documented - the branch follows future curation automatically). Steps and functions that fail on EVERY server OS are deliberately absent: they belong to the server compatibility test, not to the Linux delta. Needs the plug-in platform map for the plug-in source; all statements come from the curated FileMaker reference schema, never guessed from names.
